## Appearance

Nell possesses a slight, slender frame with a straight-backed figure, standing an inch taller than [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md). Her features include a bright, ethereal face with a sharp, small pointed chin, a pleasant and pretty nose dusted with seven freckles, and a slender, alabaster neck. She has large, starry gray eyes, which have also been noted as gleaming gray-green, set against a freckled, milk-white complexion with cheeks that easily show a rose hue. Her hair is prominently described as red, ginger, fiery, or auburn, often worn in long crimson braids or plaits, though it has also appeared green at times.

## Personality

Characterized by an unusually intense temperament, she combines an unselfish, compliant nature with an obstinate streak, an impetuous style, and a swift temper. She is highly intelligent, remarkably talkative, optimistic, and intensely imaginative, though her fondness for elevated phrasing and theatricality is sometimes mistaken for mockery. Her vivid imagination frequently leads her into reveries mid-chore, while her tendency to harbor lingering animosity contrasts with the passionate, fervent affection she directs toward those she adores. Alongside a deep appreciation for nature, romance, and pink, she enjoys people, is fond of children, and demonstrates a clever talent for engaging with youngsters. Academically and artistically, she excels in English studies and essay writing, showing a marked literary gift for crafting stories, poetry, creative garden idylls, and small pieces for young readers, even though she is an exceptionally fast runner who struggles with basic cooking despite having learned to bake cakes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P18](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P20](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. ## History

Born in [Harborough](../codex/places.md#harborough), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), Nell Harcourt was raised in an orphan asylum until she was brought to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) by [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) to live with him and [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md). During her youth at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), she formed a life-long friendship oath with [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md) in the [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill) garden and spent time preparing to become a teacher. Although she qualified to attend Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy), she initially surrendered her scholarship to care for [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and teach locally in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) after Obed's sudden death and Thirza's failing eyesight. She later pursued higher education at [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college) alongside friends like [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md) and [Cressida Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md). Throughout her young adulthood, she navigated multiple marriage proposals, initially rejecting romantic advances from [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Barney Pullen](../character/barney-pullen.md), and [Cyril Lisle](../character/cyril-lisle.md). However, she eventually reconciled her feelings and accepted Hugh's proposal in [Dinah](../character/dinah-wren.md) Wren's hidden garden. After their wedding, Nell moved with Hugh to a house near [Seven Gulls Harbor](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-harbor), where she forged a deep bond with her troubled neighbor [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md) and supported Captain Saul [Garrick](../character/uncle-saul.md). After enduring the heartbreaking loss of her first child, [Joyce](../character/joyce.md), Nell gave birth to a healthy son, [James Obed](../character/james-obed.md). As their family grew and local circumstances shifted, she tearfully bade farewell to their first home in [Seven Gulls Harbor](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-harbor) to relocate to the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen).

## Quotes

> "If you were a parentless child who arrived at a spot expected to be your home, only to discover you were undesired for not being a male, you would weep as well. Oh, my life has never known a more calamitous event!"
>
> — Nell Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P11](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0011)

> "yet, oh, I beg you to address me as Lucinda. What name you use for me cannot be of great importance to you if my stay is to be merely brief, can it? Besides, Nell is a name so lacking in romance."
>
> — Nell Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P19](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0019)

> "why failed you to inform me at the depot that I was unwanted and abandon me at that place? Had I not observed the Petal Road of Delight and the Lake of Glassy Waters, this would be less difficult."
>
> — Nell Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P25](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0025)

> "She acquired Lily Jones for her own. Lily has reached just five years of age and is extremely beautiful, possessing nut-brown hair. Were I extremely beautiful with nut-brown hair, would you retain me?"
>
> — Nell Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P29](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0029)

> "In what way is it possible for you to term the night good, given your awareness that it has to be the most terrible one I have ever experienced?"
>
> — Nell Harcourt — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P49](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0049)

## Relationships

### [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/agatha-sowerby--nell-harcourt.md)

When Mrs. Sowerby first visited [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and mocked Nell's plain looks and red hair, Nell lost her temper and shouted at her in a rage [S1]. Following persuasion from [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md), Nell delivered a humble apology to Mrs. Sowerby, who accepted it and offered her hope [S2]. Mrs. Sowerby later provided guidance on handling Nell's temper [S5, S6] and eventually praised her growth and grace [S19, S21].

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IX. ### [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-lavinia--nell-harcourt.md)

Nell and [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) formed a warm friendship after an accidental mishap where Nell jumped onto Aunt Lavinia's bed late at night [S7, S8]. Nell took full responsibility and apologized directly, winning over the strict woman with her honesty and charm [S8]. [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) later welcomed Nell into her home in town to attend the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition) and local concerts [S9].

### [Carrow](../character/carrow.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/carrow--nell-harcourt.md)

Nell and [Carrow](../character/carrow.md) shared a tumultuous history, initially clashing in school where Nell smashed a slate over his head for teasing her hair, refusing his attempts to make amends [S5, S6]. Over time, they became academic rivals competing for top marks [R4], until eventually forming a close friendship [R7]. They ultimately married, settling together in a new home near [Seven Gulls Harbor](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls-harbor) where they shared happy moments walking in their garden [S13, S16, S17].

Edmund was Nell's late father [R61]. Nell felt a deep connection to him after reading old letters written by her parents during a visit to her childhood home in [Harborough](../codex/places.md#harborough) [S173].

[Isolde Duckett](../character/isolde-duckett.md) was a close friend of Nell's [R62]. ### [Thora](../character/thora.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--thora.md)

[Thora](../character/thora.md) Sweet was a landlady and companion who hosted Nell at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside) in [Coombe Road](../codex/places.md#coombe-road) [R64, S183, S184]. [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) was a good companion to Nell who visited [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls) [R65, S187].
